reviews.classification: later source correction, institutional scope and stale readiness reconciled
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers308input lines, W1–W4/43020words, every coordinator-check/institution/role/currency/clock/search/gap row, F1–F10, ten unnamed engine rows, C1–C10, five floor cards and later independent/W3 addenda. Truncated combined output was recovered through complete named ranges before credit. Supplied English EPUB SHA798bfee32222c8b67131266f43ea58a39875b110b06dd0810f0b35e162ad71e1,644members, printed/member/ordinal offsets and stripped versus locator-inflated word counts remain distinct. Duplicate Calibre IDs are one edition, not corroborating sources. Fan-translation/authenticity/completeness uncertainty and mid-battle ending stay explicit. No novel source body was newly read.

F2: Later section16 downgrades C1's7versus43years from a demonstrated contradiction to an unresolved interval/cumulative reading;33years at stars1–4 is one life, not a universal cost. Keep exact life, stage, start/end and event for any duration. Later section17 already links the actual minimal kit card, superseding early no-card and register-before-another-pass follow-ups. Old unactivated-profile/no-runtime findings remain dated; a profile or source-read receipt does not establish an implemented regressor branch or its absence everywhere today. Retire one-realm milestone deferral against PROJECT, without selecting new reading or gameplay.

F3: Ten-day10SSadmission/40dayevent, recommendation token, contest placing, rank threshold, interview, family relationship, official role and teaching hours grant distinct rights. A paid ticket or recommendation does not gate every institution. Extended elder instruction is actor choice, not an unlimited entitlement. Belt stage/potential, actual cultivation, chosen concealment, evidence and observer perception remain separate. The source's fox opening, later conference and monthly clan duty are different periods, not three already available gates in one source-supported first day. Regressor memory/understanding carry does not give every ordinary entrant a regression reset.

F4: Spirit-stone money, silver denomination, ancient-stone1:100reportedexchange and stone-volume180liters differ. Pouch50is a purchase, not a rent quote; bracelet300/27beads/3volumeunits is not300spirit-stones capacity. Ship60000quote/2000reduction/58000inferrednet and separate80000budget preserve actual transaction state. No stable silver-to-spirit exchange is established, so herb-sale silver cannot silently fund a10SSticket. At-least-one-stone clan support is a floor plus unspecified material support, not a universal salary. Source actor statements about coercive pills, jurisdiction or lifespans retain speaker/era and exceptions; refusal and ordinary support remain useful routes.

F5: Four literal auction hits occur in three named members; sparse translated terms do not prove no auction culture or authorize an all-world exclusion. Observed auctions with unopened procedure, broker/guild/tax/bounty/retreat hits and price/meal/wage gaps retain exact scope. The dossier's information network means no broker in these windows is not whole-source absence. Memory, provenance claims, rumor and each cycle's counterpart knowledge differ; m80reset evidence alone does not source-check m58's claimed provenance explanation. Idle/compressed play can preserve due events and supported tactics under AD52. Keep useful timed rights, source-specific institution roles, supported service/stock, understanding reset/carry and separate clocks in the existing WORLD/card owners; no raw source, current runtime, build, browser, save or human acceptance proof occurs.

reviews.reopen: Keep exact source/life/clock and actual supplier/consumer; inspect current implementation before selecting any gameplay and preserve unresolved source gaps.

Exact translation aliases, audit versus paragraph locators and title/counter numbering remain separate. No novel body or second translation was newly read.

F2: Section19 supersedes earlier packet blockers: the pool entry rule is located; monthly10CPpick, yearly-stake thought and yearly-limit recollection still conflict. Rigged-winner belief is Lu's conclusion and later fate-lure material does not prove physical draw manipulation. Staking10is expense credited to pool, not wage or mission income. Odds and monthly/yearly choice remain authored/unresolved rather than a source constant. Two different lives selling tenat2000for20000gross and twentyat3000for60000gross do not conflict; gross sales are not net profit. The unsupported3000/4000/5000climb is distinct from checked descending steps. Literal no-CP hits do not establish no later prices or institutions.

F3: A1000principal,36percent/year, ten-year loan has stated460yearlyinstallment and4600total; splitting100principal+360interest is a compatible inference, not a fresh financial authority or compound rule. Three Rivers30interest-free days and36annual rate can coexist as a candidate schedule; exact accrual/payment remains qualified. Twelve rent cycles support360rent/year;30daymonths/360dayyear are authored, not source calendar. The second-half price stays unknown; guessed10000complete-formula price differs from an actual1500two-volume method sale and from the partial1000purchase/delivery. Token issue, method entitlement, item delivery, custody and actual learning are separate.

F4: Credit capped at a stated total person-value is an institutional claim, not a proven guarantee of recovery or profit. Replace salvage-value paraphrase in SCOUT with total value and preserve its history. In the observed intake reset, debt collection is not seen and first-exchange eligibility is renewed; sect forgiveness, every later anchor reset, all external creditors and completed aftermath are not proven erased. Later section18's belief-only qualification is advanced by section19's shown intake-reset case, without expanding it to all restarts. Keep body price/collateral, recovery and debt boundary separate. No forced anti-exploit defense follows from the source.

F5: Aptitude/usefulness to sect, named tiered Book talent, Golden Nature, realm, position/share and actor knowledge differ. Golden Nature can be willingly given while alive, acquired after death or supplied in a vial; defeating an NPC is not itself the settlement supplier. Settlement output, delayed activation, carry choice, retained prior start and a later anchor are different state transitions. Tiers do not supply fixed combat ranks. A single intake scene plus stated policy is not exhaustive whole-world practice; no-root reflection and unseen numeric person-prices remain source-scope questions. Keep live-source institutional coercion distinct from adopted gameplay. Late public-canon [S]labels do not create designed sealed IDs or player discovery proof.

F6: Initial21earlychapters plus W2six plus W4six yield33distinct fully windowed chapters below100, and seven selected later chapters, under the reported historical ranges; targeted W5paragraph opens do not add whole-chapter credit. This is receipt arithmetic, not new source reading. Old lists that call those same ranges unread are superseded by their exact union; audits and keyword opens keep separate depth. Existing minimal card supersedes no-card claims; READY/rank1 is historical packet readiness, not current gameplay certification. Inspect applicable shared economy/carry/restart consumers before new fields/modules; old names are not a tested current implementation. Retire the first-milestone deferral. Preserve exact missing-source, integration, reward/clock/debt/pool and second-half-price gaps without acquisition, worker, runtime edit or fresh behavior proof.
